title: Design and integrate new BunkPro logo set (icon + wordmark) with dark/light variants

requirements.text: Generate a new modern, minimal, professional BunkPro logo set that follows the provided style requirements (flat, clean, premium/tech, Gen‑Z, recognizable at 48×48) and includes: (1) app icon only (square), (2) full horizontal logo with text, each in both dark-background and light-background variants, using the palette centered on deep purple #6C4DFF (optionally an indigo gradient) with soft white/light gray and an optional subtle neon blue/pink accent; typography must be modern geometric sans-serif with rounded edges, with “Bunk” bold and “Pro” lighter, and the tagline text exactly “Track Smart.”.

quotes: Create a modern, minimal, and professional logo... Layout versions required: App icon only (square format) Full logo with text (horizontal layout) Dark background version Light background version ... Tagline below in small font: “Track Smart.”

acceptanceCriteria: Four logo images are produced as static assets (icon + horizontal wordmark) with both dark-background and light-background variants.
Logos are flat/minimal (no heavy 3D), avoid mascots/playful fonts/too many colors/complex illustrations.
Primary color uses deep purple #6C4DFF or an indigo gradient; secondary colors are soft white/light gray; any accent glow is subtle and does not reduce legibility.
The icon remains clearly recognizable when rasterized/viewed at 48×48.
Typography matches: modern sans-serif, geometric/rounded feel; “Bunk” visually heavier than “Pro”; tagline text exactly “Track Smart.” appears in the full logo variant.

requirements.text: Add the newly generated logo assets to the app as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated and wire them into all existing branding placements (at minimum: Initial loading splash and Settings → About), selecting the appropriate dark/light variant based on current theme.

quotes: Layout versions required: ... Dark background version Light background version

acceptanceCriteria: All new logo files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced via absolute paths (e.g., /assets/generated/...).
Initial loading splash and Settings → About display the new logo, with a dark-variant used in dark mode and a light-variant used in light mode.
No remaining UI surfaces show the previous generated logo file path(s).

requirements.text: Update the app’s branding constants so that (a) the tagline displayed in the UI uses the exact text “Track Smart.” and (b) the logo path(s) support theme-aware dark/light selection without editing any immutable frontend paths.

quotes: Tagline below in small font: “Track Smart.”

acceptanceCriteria: The displayed tagline in Settings → About is exactly “Track Smart.”.
Branding constants provide a clear way to retrieve the correct logo asset for dark vs light mode (used by splash and about views).
No changes are made to any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

requirements.text: Generate and set a matching favicon based on the new app icon, and ensure frontend/index.html references the updated favicon file under frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: A 32×32 PNG favicon asset is present under frontend/public/assets/generated.
frontend/index.html references the new favicon file path.
Browser tab icon updates to the new design after reload (with normal cache-busting expectations during development).

constraints: Frontend must remain React + TypeScript + Tailwind + React Query; do not introduce other frameworks.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any path listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep all changes limited to branding/assets integration; do not alter attendance logic or persistence behavior.
Backend (Motoko) is not required for this change; do not add backend features.
nonGoals: Do not redesign or change any attendance tracking functionality, calculations, notifications behavior, or data storage.
Do not add new screens or navigation items.
Do not introduce third-party font/CDN dependencies unless already present in the project.

required: Minimal flat app icon mark (calendar/checkmark OR calendar/graph arrow OR progress-ring ‘B’), deep purple #6C4DFF with subtle indigo gradient (bunkpro-app-icon-light.dim_1024x1024.png)
Minimal flat app icon mark (same design), optimized for dark backgrounds (bunkpro-app-icon-dark.dim_1024x1024.png)
Horizontal logo with icon + ‘BunkPro’ wordmark (Bunk bold, Pro lighter) + tagline ‘Track Smart.’, optimized for light backgrounds (bunkpro-logo-horizontal-light.dim_1600x500.png)
Horizontal logo with icon + ‘BunkPro’ wordmark (Bunk bold, Pro lighter) + tagline ‘Track Smart.’, optimized for dark backgrounds (bunkpro-logo-horizontal-dark.dim_1600x500.png)
Favicon derived from the app icon mark (bunkpro-favicon.dim_32x32.png)
